title: botanical-name (JavaScript/TypeScript): parse, normalize and format botanical plant names
description:
Parse, normalize and format botanical plant names following the ICN and ICNCP: hybrids, infraspecific ranks, authors, cultivar groups, trade designations and cultivars, with correct italics in HTML. Zero dependencies.

Built for and used in production by PlantGeekz, the plant identification and collection app. More open source from PlantGeekz: plantgeekz.com/open-source.
